 K-Beauty Fans, These Are the Sephora Finds Worth Adding to Your Cart
 Elle Follow Natalia Trejo Wed, October 28, 2026 at 2:30 PM UTC Add to Preferred Sources Wed, October 28, 2026 at 2:30 PM UTC Sephora's Must-Shop K-Beauty Finds Smith Collection/Gado - Getty Images "Hearst Magazines and Yahoo may earn commission or revenue on some items through these links." 
 Quick Overview Glow Recipe Vegan PDRN Tinted Soft Matte Lip Blur Balm™ for Hydration
 $22 at sephora.com Beauty of Joseon Revive Firming Moisturizer Ginseng Ceramide + Fermented Retinol
 $24 at sephora.com Beauty of Joseon Revive Serum
 $17 at sephora.com Aestura ATOBARRIER365 Cream Moisturizer with Ceramides & Niacinamide for Skin Moisture Barrier Repair
 $21 at sephora.com Yepoda The Calm Balm - K Beauty Oil Cleanser with Olive & Coconut Oil
 $28 at sephora.com See 7 more Korean beauty, a.k.a. K-beauty , has long since moved past trend status and into the realm of staple. What began in western countries more than 10 years ago as a fascination with glass skin and 10-step routines has evolved into a smarter, more personalized approach to skin care , one built on gentle formulas, innovative ingredients like snail mucin, centella, and fermented rice, and textures that make every step feel like a treat. Now, the best of the category is easier to find than ever. Whether you're a longtime devotee or just curious about the hype, Sephora offers a well-edited lineup of cult favorites and under-the-radar newcomers.
 From hydrating toners and innovative makeup to sunscreen that actually feels good to wear, here are the K-beauty products worth adding to your cart.
 1) Glow Recipe Vegan PDRN Tinted Soft Matte Lip Blur Balm™ for Hydration
 Glow Recipe Vegan PDRN Tinted Soft Matte Lip Blur Balm™ for Hydration 
 PDRN and blurred lips are both fast becoming cult favorites, and this lip product sits right at the intersection of skin care and makeup. Available in six different shades, there's a fit for every skin tone.
 4.4/5 stars
 A reviewer says : "I got this today and I'm probably gonna finish it in like 2 months. I love this product sooo much!!! It solved my cracked lips."
 Pros Doesn't dry out lips
 Cons A user mentioned the bottle's design affects reaching product.
 $22 at sephora.com 2) Beauty of Joseon Revive Firming Moisturizer Ginseng Ceramide + Fermented Retinol
 Beauty of Joseon Revive Firming Moisturizer Ginseng Ceramide + Fermented Retinol 
 If you're looking to target dull skin and the look of fine lines and wrinkles, this product is said to do just that, with a gentle, non-sticky finish. It pairs fermented retinol with copper peptides, two heavy hitters in skin care.
 4.5/5 stars
 A reviewer says: "Fantastic lightweight retinol. Non irritating and gentle. Luxurious and silky in its touch! I liked pairing it with a heavy moisturizer to wake up to bouncy and glowing skin!"
 Pros Targets dull skin and wrinkles
 Cons Someone noted they got a dry patch after using
 $24 at sephora.com 3) Beauty of Joseon Revive Serum 
 Beauty of Joseon Revive Serum 
 Along with snail mucin and ginseng extract, centella asiatica and mushroom extracts are two of the powerhouse ingredients in this serum. The formula addresses loss of elasticity and uneven skin tone while delivering an extra boost of moisture.
 4.5/5 stars
 A reviewer says : "This gives me that natural healthy glow that no other product has been able to give me"
 Pros Addresses tired skin
 Cons A user complained about dry skin the morning after
 $17 at sephora.com 4) Aestura ATOBARRIER365 Cream Moisturizer with Ceramides & Niacinamide for Skin Moisture Barrier Repair
 Aestura ATOBARRIER365 Cream Moisturizer with Ceramides & Niacinamide for Skin Moisture Barrier Repair 
 This rich cream works to target dryness so normal to dry skin types benefit best from it. With a triple lipid complex and a capsule technology that keeps ceramides in the skin barrier longer, this moisturizer is set to have you covered all winter long.
 4.5/5 stars
 A reviewer says: "My favourite moisturizer that I keep buying. No fragrance, no essential oils, rich moisturizer that saved my skin from damage multiple times!"
 Pros Feels rich and moisturizing
 Cons Someone said they felt it was basic.
 $21 at sephora.com 5) Yepoda The Calm Balm - K Beauty Oil Cleanser with Olive & Coconut Oil
 Yepoda The Calm Balm - K Beauty Oil Cleanser with Olive & Coconut Oil 
 K-beauty is known for double cleansing, and this cleansing balm is a gentle first step for removing makeup, sebum, and other impurities. It's formulated with hydrating heroes like olive oil, coconut oil, and shea butter for an extra dose of moisture.
 4.8/5 stars
 A reviewer says : "I love this oil-balm cleanser! It's the perfect pre-cleanse to your regular cleanser (or by itself) and helps take off your makeup at the same time. Love the texture of this product! Perfect for oily skin too."
 Pros Gentle on the skin
 Cons A user noted mascara was hard to remove
 $28 at sephora.com 6) Glow Recipe Prickly Pear Peptide Mucin
 Glow Recipe Prickly Pear Peptide Mucin 
 Beyond the pretty pink bottle, this vegan snail mucin serum helps with dryness, fine lines, and redness. Powered by prickly pear and ectoin, it hydrates, strengthens, and repairs the skin barrier, essentially doing it all.
 4.5/5 stars
 A reviewer says: "Love this product and I get compliments on my skin all the time. I don't mind the scent but I understand why people are offended by it. Definitely give her a chance!!"
 Pros Multitasking
 Cons The smell may be strong
 $32 at Sephora 7) beplain MUNG BEAN pH-BALANCED CLEANSING FOAM Pore-focused Cleansing
 beplain MUNG BEAN pH-BALANCED CLEANSING FOAM Pore-focused Cleansing 
 This mung bean cleanser takes on oiliness, visible pores, and uneven texture without stripping, leaving skin soft, smooth, and refreshed.
 4.8/5 stars
 A reviewer says : "This cleansed my face AMAZINGLY. My skin doesn't feel tight after, and I am noticing a great shine. I have loved using this product so far, and look forward to continuing using it. I feel very clean after."
 Pros Doesn't strip the skin
 Cons Someone noted it was pricey
 $26 at sephora.com 8) innisfree Green Tea Ceramide Milk Toner for Hydration & Barrier Repair
 innisfree Green Tea Ceramide Milk Toner for Hydration & Barrier Repair 
 A milky toner that won't trigger breakouts is already a winner in our book. This one's lightweight and fast-absorbing and it leaves skin glowy—not greasy or sticky.
 4.7/5 stars
 A reviewer says: "Amazing, moisturizing, super soothing. I use it on retinal nights of my routine and anytime my skin is feeling extra sensitive."
 Pros Won't trigger breakouts
 Cons A user said they didn't notice a difference
 $24 at sephora.com 9) Kaja Kaja Juicy Glass Lip Plumping Oil
 Kaja Kaja Juicy Glass Lip Plumping Oil 
 Glass skin, but for your lips! This plumping lip oil delivers a juicy, cushiony look without any stinging. It's hydrating and non-sticky, giving lips a glassy shine before settling into a sheer stain.
 4.5/5 stars
 A reviewer says : "Best Lip oil!! Doesn't have a strong scent, leaves my lips feelings super moisturized and soft! Love the little heart inside the applicator, super cute! Highly recommend!"
 Pros Non-sticky finish
 Cons A user complained about a strong smell
 $18 at sephora.com 10) Kaja Kaja Dewy Bar Blush & Lip Balm
 Kaja Kaja Dewy Bar Blush & Lip Balm 
 Cheeks and lips, one swipe. This dewy blush and lip bar gives you a juicy flush that looks like you just came in from a crisp fall walk. Apple extract improves the appearance of texture while green tangerine extract strengthens the skin's moisture barrier.
 4.7/5 stars
 A reviewer says: "This blush has a beautiful shade—buildable, blendable, and easy to apply. It doesn't take much time and gives a natural finish."
 Pros Convenient packaging
 Cons A user noted they didn't love as a lipstick
 $25 at sephora.com 11) Jung Saem Mool Artist Cushion Radiant Glow Highlighter
 Jung Saem Mool Artist Cushion Radiant Glow Highlighter 
 This cushion highlight gives skin a radiant lit-from-within glow with a paraben-free formula. Aside from the cute packaging, skin looks plump, radiant, and extra glowy.
 4.7/5 stars
 A reviewer says: "I have used so many highlighter formulations and this one by far is my favorite. It is very easy to build up for high sheen or have a natural glow. I have cool toned skin and this shade is perfect."
 Pros Easy to use
 Cons May be too subtle for some
 $23 at sephora.com 12) innisfree Daily UV Defense Sunscreen SPF 50+ PA++++, Korean Face Sunscreen
 innisfree Daily UV Defense Sunscreen SPF 50+ PA++++, Korean Face Sunscreen 
 Sunscreen you'll actually want to wear. This SPF glides on lightweight, leaves no white cast, and layers easily under makeup. It's a win-win-win situation.
 4.7/5 stars
 A reviewer says: "Not even joking this is the best sunscreen i've ever used. As a black woman it leaves no white cast!! Doesn't break me out and it feels soo good on my skin."
 Pros Leaves no white cast
 Cons A user noted they broke out after
